svg.aria-label: Video transcoding architecture. The preprocessor splits the video into GOP chunks and builds the DAG; the DAG scheduler turns it into stages of tasks in the resource manager's task queue. Inside the resource manager, the scheduler 1 takes the highest-priority task, 2 picks the best worker from the worker queue, 3 tells that task worker (video encoder, thumbnail or watermark) to run it, and 4 tracks it in the running queue until it finishes. Workers write the output files. Temporary storage keeps metadata in memory and video and audio in blob storage until the job is done.
svg.title: Transcoding architecture
